svg.text: McCzarny recently pushed multiple updates
across three repositories. In
McCzarny/chromium-daily-digest, he disabled
scheduled summary generation to save tokens,
adding a banner to inform users. He also
adjusted cron schedules to prevent workflow
overlaps and introduced a limit of 25 summary
points for commit digests to improve
conciseness. Additionally, he enhanced OpenCode
model protocol handling and increased the
commit fetch limit to 2000. For
McCzarny/opencode-sessions, he significantly
refactored the build process, migrating from
Rollup to esbuild and updating TypeScript to
v7, while also pinning TypeScript to 5.x to fix
a previous build issue. He improved session
status display to accurately show "NEEDS INPUT"
when sessions are waiting for user input,
updated development dependencies, and clarified
the README regarding OpenCode V2 service
interaction. In McCzarny/dcvis, he made several
updates related to data center information,
including wording fixes and adding details
about the "Trzebnica" and "Piaseczno" data
centers.
